meta.title: Double O — a chatbot that answers visitors and books appointments, 24/7
meta.description: A chatbot for your website, Instagram and Viber/WhatsApp that answers enquiries and books appointments in your place — plus lead reactivation, content and, as an upgrade, an AI phone receptionist. Book a free strategy call.

hero.h1: A chatbot that answers every visitor and books the appointment.
hero.sub: One chatbot across your website, Instagram and Viber/WhatsApp — answering questions and booking appointments around the clock. One brain, every channel, no new hire.
hero.note: Free strategy call · no obligation · you keep the plan either way

heroCard.aria: Chatbot preview: Nova answering a visitor and booking an appointment
heroCard.name: Nova
heroCard.q: Hi! Are you open Saturday? I'd like to book a haircut.
heroCard.a: We are — Saturday at 11:00 is free. Want me to book it for you?
heroCard.foot: Answered and booked in seconds — no one lifted a finger.

problem.intro: Small businesses don’t lose work because they’re bad at it. They lose it because nobody picks up in time, nobody follows up, and the brand goes quiet. Those aren’t three small flaws — they’re three holes draining money you already paid to attract.

l1.leak: A visitor messages you on Instagram: “Are you open Saturday?” Your reply lands on Monday — they’ve already booked with a competitor who answered in two minutes.
l1.fix: The chatbot replies in seconds — on your site, Instagram and Viber — and books the appointment before the visitor moves on.

l2.leak: Hundreds of old enquiries sit in a spreadsheet. You already paid for every one of them — in ads, time and work. Nobody calls them anymore.
l2.fix: Reactivation reaches out with a concrete reason to come back. Revenue from a list that was just sitting there.

l3.leak: A quiet profile looks like a closed shop. Customers can’t find you on Google, and trust erodes with every week you don’t post.
l3.fix: The content system publishes for you — consistently, in your voice — and writes the SEO articles that make Google recommend you.

problem.outro: The answer isn’t another hire. It’s a system that never sleeps, never forgets and never asks for a break.

solutions.h2: One chatbot, three channels — and the systems around it.
solutions.intro: The chatbot sits at the centre, catching every enquiry. Around it we build the supporting systems — content, reactivation and instant lead response — and, as an upgrade, a phone receptionist.

s1.name: Chatbot
s1.h3: One brain. Three channels. No enquiry left unanswered.
s1.body: The same chatbot answers on your website, in Instagram DMs and on Viber/WhatsApp. It knows your services, prices and schedule, answers common questions, books appointments and consultations straight into the calendar, and hands you only what needs a human. One solution learns once — every channel speaks in the same voice.
s1.ideal: clinics, salons, service businesses, agencies — any business that gets questions before it gets customers

v.c1d: visitors researching before they reach out
v.foot: Same brain, same voice — across all three.

s2.name: Content Dashboard
s2.h3: A brand that never goes quiet.
s2.body: Ready-to-post social content — visual, copy, schedule — plus SEO articles for your site. Your audience sees you every week, and Google finds you when someone searches for what you do.
s2.ideal: brands that post inconsistently or have gone quiet altogether

s3.name: Lead Reactivation
s3.h3: Revenue from the list you already own.
s3.body: A voice agent (email works too) calls your old and inactive contacts with a concrete reason to return. People you already paid to acquire — billed a second time.
s3.ideal: any business sitting on a database of past or unconverted leads

s4.name: Speed to Lead
s4.h3: You reach every lead first. Every time.
s4.body: The moment someone leaves their details — through an ad, a form, a message — the system calls or texts them right away, while interest is at its peak and before your competitors have even seen the enquiry.
s4.ideal: businesses running paid ads or collecting inbound form leads

s5.name: AI UGC Creatives
s5.h3: More creatives, faster testing, a fraction of the cost.
s5.body: AI-generated UGC-style video ads — no creator hunting, no waiting on shoots. Instead of three variants a month, thirty: more tests, faster learning, a lower cost per winning ad.
s5.ideal: e-commerce and DTC brands that rely on UGC ads

s6.name: AI Receptionist
s6.h3: The next step: once the chatbot covers messages, but missed calls remain.
s6.body: Once the chatbot takes on written enquiries, the phone is the last gap left. The AI receptionist answers incoming calls in your brand’s voice, handles common questions and books appointments. An upgrade to the chatbot, not a separate product — we add it once call volume justifies it.
s6.ideal: businesses where plenty of phone calls remain even after the chatbot

process.h2: From one call to a running system

s1.title: Free strategy call
s1.body: We walk through how you operate and pinpoint exactly where revenue leaks: missed enquiries, forgotten leads, a dead list, silence online. You leave with a concrete plan — whether you work with us afterwards or not.

s2.title: We build the system
s2.body: We do everything, end to end: the system learns your voice, your services and your rules, and plugs into the tools you already use — calendar, phone, CRM. You don’t touch a thing.

s3.title: It runs — you watch the results
s3.body: The calendar fills, old contacts write back, posts go out on time. You do the work you know — the system handles everything you used to miss.

why.h2: We don’t sell technology. We sell the result.
why.body: We’re marketing and operations people first, “AI” second. Technology is the tool — what you get is booked appointments, revived leads, higher conversion from the same budget, and a brand that’s always present. If a system doesn’t deliver that, we don’t build it.

p1.b: From strategy to go-live. Your job is to keep running your business.

p2.b: Fully remote, reachable 24/7 — same as the systems we build.

p3.b: No price list, no tiers. We establish what makes you money first, then scope the project — the value you receive always exceeds the price you pay.

cta.h2: Find out where your revenue is leaking.
cta.body: A short call, a concrete plan, zero obligation. If you decide to do it all yourself afterwards — the plan is yours to keep.
